in_marathi.name: Akarsh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akarsh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akarsh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘akarshana’, which means ‘desire’ or ‘ambition’. In Hindu mythology, Akarsh is the name of a god associated with the planet Mars and the god of war, Kartikeya. He is revered for his courage, strength, and leadership qualities. This name is an excellent choice for parents who wish to inspire a sense of determination and ambition in their child.
